kept.desc: Silent failure in fs.rmSync catch block leaves legacy cache file on disk without logging; security cleanup failure is invisible to caller
.catch(() => {}) silently swallows DELETE errors during fallback cleanup; should at least log or warn before proceeding
Catch block swallows load error silently; component shows empty state without notifying user that the fetch failed, unlike other error handlers in the same component that toast errors.
API response is cast to InvoiceOption[] without validation; malformed JSON from /api/finances/invoices could bypass type safety and cause runtime errors downstream.
Type assertion assumes response has booking property; if missing, saved becomes undefined and is passed to onsaved without validation.
Promise rejection from client initialization and event capture silently swallowed with no handler or logged context
Catch block swallows all exceptions from descriptor access and validation without propagating or logging
c.tag_ids is spread without checking if it exists; c.auto_tag_ids is safely guarded with ??[], but tag_ids is not, risking a TypeError if tag_ids is undefined or null

The preferences.preferences.calendar property chain is accessed without optional chaining or null checks before the type assertion; if parent layout data lacks this nested structure, the code will throw a runtime error.
TODO(handoff) comment documenting a known UTC wall-clock rendering bug was removed without transferring the issue to a proposal file, violating the handoff contract in AGENTS.md.
